Lepas L6 Is a New Chinese EV Aimed at the UK, Find Out Here How Much It Costs
6 photos
Photo: Lepas UK
Chinese automakers keep invading Europe (and not only) with various models, and one of the latest to have touched down is the Lepas L6 EV.
The model, which is a rebadged version of the Chery Fulwin T7 marketed in the People’s Republic, which is also known as the Tenet Plus L6 in Russia, is assembled in China, Thailand, and Russia, and it’s a compact crossover that is now available to order in the United Kingdom.
Pricing kicks off at 34,995 pounds (equaling $46,085) on-the-road, and that’s for the base Essence, because the Lepas L6 EV is also available in the Elevate trim level, and in this case, you are looking at a minimum of 36,995 pounds ($48,715).
Ordering the entry-level model means that your car will come with LED lighting with intelligent high-beam assist, diamond-cut 19-inch alloys, rear privacy windows, and a panoramic sunroof with an electric sunshade. The dual-zone climate control, a heated multi-function steering wheel, an 8.88-inch digital gauge cluster, a 13.2-inch infotainment screen, 50W wireless charging pad for compatible smartphones with active cooling, and voice assistant are also included.
In terms of safety features, the Lepas L6 EV comes with a 540-degree panoramic camera system, front and rear parking sensors, autonomous emergency braking system, lane keeping assist, blind spot detection, traffic jam assist, and adaptive cruise control.
Photo: Lepas UK Those who fancy getting the superior version , namely the Elevate, will enjoy additional other features. These include the six-way power-adjustable seats for the driver and front passenger with a four-way power lumbar support in the former case, heated and ventilated seats at the front, full leather-effect upholstery, a 256-color ambient lighting system, an eight-speaker audio system from Sony, a power tailgate, remote parking assist, and advanced parking assist.
Over-the-air and firmware-over-the-air updates are also a thing, and regardless of the selected trim level, all versions of the Lepas L6 EV feature the same powertrain. It is a front-mounted electric motor that drives the front wheels, generating 217 ps (160 kW/214 hp) and 275 Nm (203 lb-ft) of torque. The EV needs 7.9 seconds to hit 62 mph (100 kph) from a standstill, the automaker says.
A 65 kWh lithium iron phosphate battery pack feeds electrons to the electric motor, enabling a WLTP-rated range of 279 miles (449 km). The battery supports up to 120 kW DC charging, and can be juiced up from 30 to 80 percent in 22 minutes.
According to the automaker, the Lepas L6 EV is 4,570 mm (106.3 in) long, 1,852 mm (72.9 in) wide, excluding the mirrors, and 1,676 mm (66 in) tall. The space between the axles measures 2,700 mm (106.3 in). Both versions are accompanied by a 7-year / 100,000-mile (160,934 km) manufacturer warranty, and an 8-year / 100,000-mile warranty for the high-voltage battery pack.
